name: Bruggerhof
beschreibung: The campsite Bruggerhof is located on the southern outskirts of Kitzbühel. The Kitzbüheler Alpen shape the immediate surroundings of the campsite. A network of hiking and cycling trails is directly accessible from the site. The nearby Schwarzsee offers a swimming opportunity in summer. In winter, the ski areas Kitzbühel and the SkiWelt Wilder Kaiser-Brixental can be reached via nearby valley stations. The site offers pitches for motorhomes and caravans, rental accommodations, and an area for tents. The facilities include sanitary facilities, a Restaurant, a grocery store, and a wellness area. The site is surrounded by meadows and forest.
